cs.t: I have a pair audio-technica headphones, using them regularly for about 12 years... I have pair of Monsoon Speakers bought since College (2000), so that's over 20 years.  They still work great, just an headjack input, volume/bass control.  Simple and they are connected to my PS4. I have a dell monitor, bought in 2006, still working great with my mac.  I bought an LG 4k one last year, and the Thubderbolt port just failed.  Right now it is staying as a dead weight, and I am deciding if it is even worth fixing (or it can be fixed). Some accessories do last decades.  Apple accessories are made to last for 2-3 years and discarded after as they are not easily serviceable.
